Paragraph: "Recall your incomparable power and noble heritage; grief does not belong to a hero of your stature!"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama's temporary forgetfulness of his own inner strength due to acute sorrow.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana reminds Rama of his true identity, core strengths, and noble character.
Outcome/Resolution: He re-anchors Rama in his core sense of self and capability.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Swarupa-Smarana (Remembering one's true, divine identity to transcend earthly sorrow)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Reminding the individual soul of its intrinsic strength and divine lineage restores lost confidence and peace.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Affirming self-efficacy: reminding an individual in crisis of past strengths and identity to overcome feelings of helplessness.
